name: On the Prairie
source:
On the Prairie is a choice-based visual novel set in the Old West. You play as a young man whose parents were tragically murdered when you were a child. Raised by a close friend of the family, he must find his way in this harsh world and deal with his tragic past. You will guide this young man through the choices that will shape his life and those around him.

[From [url=https://the-capngames.itch.io/on-the-prairie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《草原上》是一部以旧西部为背景的基于选择的视觉小说。你扮演一个年轻人，他的父母在你小时候惨遭谋杀。他由家人的密友抚养长大，他必须在这个严酷的世界中找到自己的出路，并处理他悲惨的过去。你将引导这个年轻人做出将塑造他和他周围人的生活的选择。

[来自[url=https://the-capngames.itch.io/on-the-prairie]Itch.io[/url]]
